title: Fibers of restriction from a hyperplane kernel
statement: Let $V$ be a finite-dimensional vector space over $\mathbb{F}_2$, let $\beta$ be a nonzero linear functional on $V$, and let $\psi,\gamma$ be linear functionals on $V$. The restrictions of $\psi$ and $\gamma$ to $\ker\beta$ are equal if and only if $\psi=\gamma$ or $\psi=\gamma+\beta$.
hypotheses_covered: $V$ is an additive commutative group and a vector space over $\mathbb{F}_2$
